config.description: When the page goes idle and what wakes it. Every value can be bound, so the timeout and mode can differ per page, role or display.

enabled.description: Off wakes the page at once and stops idle detection.

timeoutSec.description: Seconds without input before the page goes idle (minimum 5).

mode.description: What covers the page when idle. The default, clock, uses no graphics card at all. Driven by 'lines': pipes, aurora, halo; starfield follows modes.starfield. Showpieces, not linked to the plant: synthwave, lava, tunnel, flow. Funny: bounce, pong, ducks. 'shuffle' rotates through the animated modes (see modes.shuffle). clock and blank are plain. 'external' draws nothing: the project reacts to output.idle or onIdle/onWake itself.

wakeOnMove.description: Mouse movement counts as input. Touch, keys, wheel and clicks always do.

moveThresholdPx.description: How far the pointer must move before it counts, so a vibrating mouse on a machine frame does not keep the page awake.

wakeLock.description: Ask the browser to keep the display awake (Screen Wake Lock API). Only works over HTTPS.

quality.description: How hard the animated modes work the graphics card. 'auto' starts high and steps down when the screen cannot keep 20 frames a second (a Raspberry Pi kiosk, an old NUC). Browsers without WebGL2 get simpler 2D versions.

reduceMotion.description: For viewers who are sensitive to motion: the animated modes are replaced by the clock. 'auto' follows the browser's 'reduce motion' setting (prefers-reduced-motion), 'always' forces it (a kiosk without that setting), 'never' ignores it.

locale.description: UI-text language (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt), matched on the primary subtag, and the clock's date/time locale. Empty follows the browser.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale.

activeAlarm.description: Banner count for one active alarm.

activeAlarms.description: Banner count for several; '{n}' is the number.

line.description: Name of a line without a label; '{n}' is its number.

diagnostic.description: Priority name in the banner detail.

low.description: Priority name in the banner detail.

medium.description: Priority name in the banner detail.

high.description: Priority name in the banner detail.

critical.description: Priority name in the banner detail.

alarm.description: Alarm policy. The gateway pushes the active alarm counts to the guard every couple of seconds. An active Critical alarm always wakes the page, whatever is set here.

wakePriority.description: Any active alarm at or above this priority wakes the page and keeps it awake while it is active. Critical always does.

pinPriority.description: Active alarms at or above this priority (but below wakePriority) show as a banner over the idle mode.

includeAcked.description: Acknowledged alarms that are still active count too. Off: only unacknowledged ones wake or pin. Active Critical alarms always count.

sources.description: Only alarms whose display path or source path matches one of these patterns count. '*' matches anything, e.g. 'prov:default:/tag:Line1/*' or 'Line 1*'. Empty = every alarm on the gateway. The matching alarms' labels and display paths are sent to this browser for the banner, whoever is logged in (or nobody): on a public or lobby screen, limit them here.

staleAfterSec.description: If the gateway alarm feed is silent this long, the guard fails open: it removes the idle mode and does not idle again until the feed is back.

drift.description: Text in the idle modes (clock, legends, banners) wanders slowly so nothing stays on the same pixels.

night.description: The night window: while idle inside it the screen rests, which saves power and panel life. 'clock' (the default) shows the plain clock dimmed to 'level', so the screen still reads as alive; 'dim' keeps the configured mode dimmed to 'level'; 'blank' renders nothing. Alarms behave as always: a wake alarm wakes the page, a pinned one shows its banner (and lifts the dimming).

from.description: Start of the window, HH:MM in the browser's local time.

to.description: End of the window, HH:MM. May be earlier than 'from' (the window crosses midnight).

mode.description: What the idle screen shows inside the window.

level.description: Brightness at night for the 'clock' and 'dim' night modes: 1 = no dimming, 0 = black.

lines.description: Your lines, units or utilities: one pipe, aurora curtain or halo ring each (up to 12). Bind state and flow to tags: the colour follows the state, the motion follows the flow. Empty = a demo set.

state.description: running, idle, warning, fault or off. Picks the colour unless 'color' is set; fault also pulses.

flow.description: 0 = still; 1 = full speed (values above 1 go faster, up to 3). Drives pipe growth and flow pulses, aurora motion and halo spin.

modes.description: Settings per idle mode. The line-driven modes (pipes, aurora, halo) read 'lines'.

legend.description: Show the line labels and states over the pipes and aurora modes (halo labels its rings itself).

title.description: A line under the clock, e.g. the line or shift name.

speed.description: Warp speed. Bind it to a line rate (scaled to roughly 0-5) and the stars move with production; 0 freezes them.

color.description: Star colour (any CSS colour). Empty = white. Bind it to a line state.

caption.description: Optional text in a corner, e.g. the bound rate with its unit.

resetAfterSec.description: Start over with an empty scene after this long.

orbit.description: The camera circles the scene slowly. Off: a fixed three-quarter view.

text.description: What the bouncing badge says: a site or company name, a line name, anything short. Unset or empty: the config.locale pack's word for idle ('IDLE').

left.description: Name of the left player. Unset or empty: the config.locale pack's 'DAY SHIFT'.

right.description: Name of the right player. Unset or empty: the config.locale pack's 'NIGHT SHIFT'.

modes.description: The modes to rotate through, e.g. ["pipes", "lava", "ducks"]. Empty = every animated mode.

minutes.description: Minutes per mode before the next one fades in.

output.description: Written by the component. Bind to these to drive your own logic.

idle.description: True while the page is idle.

idleSince.description: Epoch ms the page went idle (0 while active).

lastInput.description: Epoch ms of the last input. Updated at most every few seconds.

mode.description: The mode showing while idle; empty while active.

wakeCause.description: Why the page last woke: input, alarm, feed-stale or disabled.

feedOk.description: The gateway alarm feed is live. While false the guard will not idle (it fails open).

alarms.description: Active alarm counts by priority, from the gateway feed, after the source filter.
